title: Exclusive ARC 32K CUDA load and selfparse admission preflight

field_principles.schema: A versioned shape lets readers reject incompatible receipts.
field_principles.experiment: The identifier binds this file to Exp6764.
field_principles.title: The title states the admission-only scope.
field_principles.run_date: The planning date anchors the requested hardware check.
field_principles.status: The status separates ready, partial, and blocked runs.
field_principles.field_principles: Each field states why it is needed.
field_principles.inference_substrate: The value excludes CPU, remote, and substituted inference.
field_principles.duration_s: Monotonic wall time makes real work visible.
field_principles.random_seed: The fixed seed makes model requests repeatable.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: The checksum detects receipt or input drift.
field_principles.models_used: Exact paths and hashes prevent model substitution.
field_principles.live_model_invoked: Readiness requires both real local decodes.
field_principles.rows: One row per model phase keeps lifecycle evidence atomic.
field_principles.device_inventory_before: The initial inventory exposes unrelated work and capacity.
field_principles.device_selection_receipt: The receipt proves frozen least-used selection.
field_principles.lease_owner_receipts: PID and start time bind each lease to its worker.
field_principles.phase_rows: Ordered monotonic rows prove the complete lease lifecycle.
field_principles.gpu_receipts: Separate model receipts prevent timing and evidence pooling.
field_principles.runtime_context_by_model: Observed context distinguishes load evidence from intent.
field_principles.production_selfparse_receipt: Parser, dispatch, bound, and transcript evidence prove the live route.
field_principles.owned_processes_terminated: A true value rules out an owned process leak.
field_principles.lease_release_receipts: Durable releases prove the selected device was returned.
field_principles.vram_recovery_receipts: Before and after samples prove owned VRAM returned.
field_principles.unrelated_processes_signaled: An empty list proves the no-preemption boundary.
field_principles.arc_exclusive_load_ready: The all-admission boolean requires both complete canaries.
field_principles.claim_boundary: The boundary prevents admission evidence from becoming a quality claim.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Blocked results retain each failed check and observed value.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: False states that this transport receipt is not a correctness oracle.
field_principles.verdict_class: A closed class makes the result machine-readable.
field_principles.honest_verdict: The terminal text states readiness or an owned block.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: The full gate record explains why workers did or did not start.
field_principles.owned_process_receipts: Process identities show which task-owned PIDs ended.
